cases.sentence: человек в богатой ___ и с золотым перстнем
cases.translation: A man in rich clothing with a gold ring.
cases.explain: The noun одежда is the grammatical subject, so it stands in nominative.

cases.translation: Showing favoritism to one person over another.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before/over) governs the instrumental case.
The preposition в (in) with location governs the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Do not show favoritism to the rich.
cases.explain: The dative case shows the indirect object receiving the action of showing favoritism.

cases.translation: In keeping of the entire law.
cases.explain: The genitive case shows possession; 'entire of the law'.

cases.sentence: Если ___ или сестра без одежды и без пищи
cases.translation: If a brother or sister is naked and lacks food.
cases.explain: The subject брат stands in nominative as the grammatical subject of the conditional.

cases.translation: If you truly keep the royal law.
cases.explain: The transitive verb соблюдаете (keep/observe) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: угнетают вас люди ___ и таскают вас по судам
cases.translation: Are not the rich ones who oppress you?
cases.explain: The subject богатые stands in nominative as the grammatical subject.

reading.ru: Братья мои, имейте веру в Иисуса Христа, нашего славного Господа, не оказывая предпочтения одним людям перед другими.
reading.question: What does James tell his brothers to have while avoiding favoritism?
options: Faith in Jesus Christ our glorious Lord
reading.correct: Faith in Jesus Christ our glorious Lord
reading.explain: James instructs believers to hold faith in Jesus Christ without showing partiality.

reading.ru: Если вы действительно соблюдаете царский закон, как написано «люби ближнего твоего, как самого себя», то поступаете правильно.
reading.question: What is the royal law according to James?
reading.explain: James cites the royal law as loving your neighbor as yourself, found in Scripture.

reading.ru: Разве не богатые угнетают вас и таскают вас по судам?
reading.question: Who does James identify as oppressing believers?
reading.explain: James rhetorically asks if it is not the rich who oppress believers and drag them to court.

reading.ru: Братья мои, какая польза, если человек говорит, что имеет веру, но дел не имеет?
reading.question: What is James questioning about faith without works?
reading.explain: James asks what benefit there is in claiming faith but having no deeds.

reading.ru: Так же и вера, если не имеет дел, сама по себе мертва.
reading.question: What does James say about faith without works?
reading.explain: James explicitly states that faith without works is dead in itself.

reading.ru: Не в результате ли дел наш праотец Авраам был оправдан, когда положил своего сына Исаака на жертвенник?
reading.question: How was Abraham justified according to this verse?
options: By his works, when he offered Isaac
reading.correct: By his works, when he offered Isaac
reading.explain: James demonstrates that Abraham was justified by works when he offered his son Isaac.
